purpose: Correct the liveness interpretation of the rank-one holonomy analysis by measuring the conservative projective loop-length budget and its quantization-induced erosion.

mathematical_object.edge_retention_by_half: r_e,h = abs(inner_product(u_source,h, u_target,h))^2 for the registered rank-one between-class bases
mathematical_object.cycle_angle_budget: B_gamma = sum over boundary edges e of alpha_e
mathematical_object.systolic_bound: For a closed real line-bundle cycle, w1(gamma) = -1 implies projective loop length at least 180 degrees. Therefore B_gamma < 180 degrees forces w1(gamma) = +1 in both registered halves.
mathematical_object.liveness_rule: The discrete w1 sign is empirically live only on a cycle whose conservative budget B_gamma is at least 180 degrees. Lowering the admission floor does not make w1 live when the measured angle budget remains below 180 degrees.
mathematical_object.cycle_universe: The six connected simple cycles of the frozen 2 x 4 ladder; the disconnected GF(2) cycle-chain is reported separately and cannot establish simple-loop liveness.

per_cycle: construction and validation actual angle sums
primary_estimands.per_graph: maximum B_gamma and minimum F_gamma over the six connected simple cycles
primary_estimands.paired_quantization_erosion: E_site = max_gamma B_gamma(4bit, site) - max_gamma B_gamma(float16, site), equivalently min_gamma F_gamma(float16, site) - min_gamma F_gamma(4bit, site)
primary_estimands.relative_erosion: E_site divided by the float16 minimum frustration margin, reported only when that denominator is positive
primary_estimands.matched_cycle_erosion: Also report B_gamma(4bit) - B_gamma(float16) for every identical cycle class so graph-maximum switching cannot hide the cycle identity.

resampling.pairing: One stratified half x subcondition prompt-ID bootstrap draw is reused across precision, state, site, and shard.
resampling.intervals: Empirical 0.05 and 0.95 percentile bounds over paired bootstrap replicates, with the full-sample point reported separately.
resampling.interval_warning: These are descriptive percentile intervals for max-type statistics. The full-sample point is not required to lie inside them; no bias-corrected or calibrated coverage claim is made.

registered_decisions.quantization_erosion_established: The paired lower descriptive percentile for E_site is strictly greater than zero.
registered_decisions.interpretation: If all cycles are forced orientable, the observed positive w1 signs carry no information beyond edge lineages. The frustration margin, not the topological class, is the live graded diagnostic.

controls.forced_fixture: A planted cycle with total projective edge-angle budget below 180 degrees must be labeled forced orientable.
controls.live_negative_fixture: A planted projective cycle with budget exactly 180 degrees and sign holonomy -1 must be labeled w1-live and orientation reversing.
controls.gauge_preflight: 384 independent node-sign reframings must produce zero budget, liveness, and determinant-decision mismatches.
controls.precision_pairing: Every bootstrap index array is byte-identical across the two precision conditions.

reporting.supersedes_prose_not_receipts: The sealed qwen08_precision_filtration_w1_v0_1 result and category remain immutable. Any prose saying positive w1 was empirically observed as precision-stable is superseded by this forcing analysis.
reporting.required_claim: Four-bit quantization compressed rank-one support margins, caused one local support-gate crossing, and eroded the loop angle budget toward the 180-degree frustration bound, while every measured cycle remained inside the geometrically forced orientable regime. On this capture, w1 carries no information beyond edge lineages.
reporting.claim_boundary: This is an outcome-free measurement study. It can measure projective angle budgets and bound when rank-one sign holonomy is forced or live on the frozen Qwen development capture. It cannot establish causal edit value, VPD efficacy, monitor sufficiency, capability preservation, compactification, recursive self-improvement, or RSI. It adds no attestation level and reopens no closed causal/VPD stage.
